products.title: Surface Light - Melt Medium
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Melt Medium Surface Light combines contemporary design with advanced lighting technology. This semi-metallised, gold-finished fixture features a polycarbonate shade and integrates a 6W LED delivering 800 lumens at a warm 3000K colour temperature with exceptional >90 CRI for accurate colour rendering. Fully mains dimmable with leading and trailing edge compatibility, it operates efficiently at 220-240V across 50-60Hz frequencies. Built to Class II double insulation standards and certified CB, CCC, CE, and NZ/AUS, this indoor luminaire offers 50,000 hours of reliable performance. Perfect for residential and commercial spaces requiring sophisticated ambient lighting with professional-grade specifications.

Dimensions

50x50x28cm

products.title: Pendant Lamp - Melt Mini
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
To mark the ten year anniversary of one of Tom Dixon’s most recognisable lighting collections, MELT returns with a new bronze hue. Sitting alongside the current offering, MELT Bronze is remiscent of melted chocolate and gives a warm glow. Evocative of molten glass, the MELT Mini Pendant Light in bronze produces a mesmerising hot-blown glass effect. MELT is created through a process of blow moulding and vacuum metallisation to achieve melted orbs with abundant and unusual luminosity. Suitable for either residential or commercial spaces, each shade is engraved with “10 YEARS OF MELT – Tom Dixon”, in celebration of MELT’s 10th anniversary since its launch at Salone del Mobile in 2015.

DIMENSIONS
28 × 27 × 28 cm
